sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static content page with header/title, navigation links, text blocks, a code-like horizontal block, a large image/media area, and footer/contact text. The mobile and desktop versions mainly differ by responsive reflow and content density rather than by introducing distinct interactive widgets. No clear visual evidence suggests a hamburger menu, dropdowns, sticky navigation, forms, search, accordions, tabs, modals, notifications, or progressive loading behaviors; the implied implementation is primarily HTML/CSS responsive layout rather than JavaScript-driven UI.
